indicator_name: Contribution of CPI components to month-on-month CPI growth, percentage points
description: Вклад отдельных составляющих в прирост ИПЦ за месяц, п.п.
methodology: Т-15-02-М table 6 (2023-01 onward) and BNS «Вклад отдельных составляющих …» (2020-01 to 2022-12). TOTAL is the CPI growth itself (0.571 for August 2026). May 2021 was printed in Kazakh only; its row labels are taken from April/June 2021, whose 46 rows are identical.
